name: Library Statistics
description: Scans selected Jellyfin libraries, charts storage, formats and growth, shows latest and largest titles, and compares duplicate versions with exact paths and MediaInfo.
overview: Library storage statistics, per-library formats, trends, media insights and duplicate analysis.

versions.changelog: Aligns the dashboard with Jellyfin Helper, fixes library checkboxes and table colors, removes per-library scrolling, and adds duplicate-tab 4K/1080p and synchronized MediaInfo toggles.
Fixes plugin startup on Jellyfin by removing native runtime assemblies from the package while retaining durable duplicate reviews and scan history.

Adds fast background scans with progress, real scan-snapshot trends, persistent duplicate reviews, automatic 4K plus 1080p allowances, ambiguous multipart detection, series grouping, and a compact responsive UI.
Requires complete Jellyfin episode coordinates for cross-item matching; incomplete metadata can only produce a duplicate through Jellyfin's own merged sources.
Uses metadata-only duplicate matching, resolves the Jellyfin parent season, adds Helper-style sidecar storage categories, richer media facets and file-path drilldowns.
Fixes false episode duplicates by prioritizing Jellyfin season and episode coordinates over shared provider IDs.
Adds a Duplicates-tab checkbox that limits results to items Jellyfin itself exposes with multiple merged media sources.
Makes low-count media-format categories easier to distinguish with separated, minimum-visible donut slices while retaining exact percentages in the legend.
Keeps name, library and file count, size, date, and path in stable aligned columns in the latest/largest media view.
Adds Jellyfin Helper-style category cards, storage distribution, a storage-based per-library breakdown, and per-library media-format charts.
Expands duplicate detection beyond merged versions using provider IDs and conservative title/year or episode-coordinate matching, while still requiring distinct media paths.
Reuses Jellyfin Helper's fixed donut-chart layout and arc renderer, restores scrolling throughout the dashboard, and adds a growth timeline plus latest/largest movie and series views.

Fixes repeated merged-movie groups, adds Jellyfin Helper-style donut charts, corrects unreadable select menus, clarifies library/type badges, and aligns the icon and page with Jellyfin's active theme.
First public release. Includes a Jellyfin Helper-style dashboard, selectable library exclusions, media statistics, and a merged-version duplicate finder with exact paths and per-version MediaInfo.
